results.rationale: The blue sky, desert foreground and distant horizon are preserved. Broad terraces and a central staircase are added, addressing the stepped-pyramid idea, but the structure retains a tall pointed Egyptian-style summit instead of the characteristic flat summit temple of Kukulkan. That is a clear mismatch with the named knowledge target. The edited masonry, steps and perspective are coherent.

The glass, milk stream and splash retain their original form. The white minimalist setting gains a soft gray base shadow and centered uppercase gray slogan; the terminal period is missing. The milk and glass look natural, though the title crossing the pouring stream slightly weakens separation and legibility.
